response.sql: WITH pat AS (SELECT ID, AVG(HGB) AS avg_hgb FROM Laboratory GROUP BY ID), overall AS (SELECT AVG(HGB) AS o FROM Laboratory), kept AS (SELECT p.ID, p.avg_hgb, o.o AS overall_avg FROM pat p, overall o WHERE p.avg_hgb > o.o), km AS (SELECT AVG(avg_hgb) AS m FROM kept) SELECT k.ID, k.avg_hgb AS average_hgb, k.avg_hgb - k.overall_avg AS above_overall, k.avg_hgb - km.m AS diff_from_kept_mean FROM kept k, km ORDER BY diff_from_kept_mean DESC LIMIT 10
